hero.eyebrow: Data Science, Language AI & Speech Engineering
hero.lede: I'm Afolabi Abeeb — a data scientist, machine learning engineer, and NLP researcher from Ibadan, Nigeria, working across ASR, TTS, and machine translation for low-resource languages worldwide, from research prototype to production.

about.heading: From dataset to model to production pipeline
paragraphs: I work at the intersection of data science and language AI: turning messy, real-world data into models people can actually use. I led the Language AI division at Plotweaver AI, where I set research direction and product roadmaps for multilingual speech and language systems — live commentary translation, video dubbing, audiobook generation, subtitle translation, and speech-to-speech pipelines that run across 38+ languages in real time.

My research background is in end-to-end ASR for Nigerian Pidgin, one of many low-resource languages that remain underserved by mainstream AI. I contributed the first parallel dataset for the language and fine-tuned architectures like Wav2Vec2, QuartzNet, and Jasper to push word-error rates below existing baselines. That work — and related contributions to MasakhaNews and AfriCOMET — sits at NAACL, ICLR workshops, and Deep Learning Indaba, and reflects a broader interest in making AI work for every language, not just the handful with abundant data.

As a data scientist, I care about the full pipeline: sourcing and cleaning data, statistical modelling, feature engineering, and communicating findings clearly — before a model ever gets near production. I bring the same rigor to structured data problems as I do to speech and language, and I'm equally comfortable building a forecasting model, an NLP system, or a real-time translation pipeline.

experience.title: Head of Language AI
bullets: Define research strategy and product roadmap for multilingual speech & language technologies, with a focus on low-resource African languages.
Architected production AI media systems: live commentary translation, video dubbing, audiobook generation, subtitle translation, and speech-to-speech translation.
Directed real-time ASR + MT + TTS pipelines spanning 38+ languages.
Built and fine-tuned custom ASR, MT, and TTS models for under-resourced African languages; led data collection, annotation, and QA at scale.
Managed cross-functional teams of ML engineers, NLP researchers, linguists, and data specialists.

experience.title: NLP Researcher / Engineer
bullets: Co-authored "Nigerian Pidgin++: Towards End-to-End Training of an ASR System," presenting the first parallel dataset for the language.
Trained the first end-to-end ASR systems (QuartzNet, Jasper) for Nigerian Pidgin, and fine-tuned Wav2Vec2 variants, surpassing baseline word-error rates.
Open-sourced data and code to encourage further research.

experience.title: NVIDIA RAPIDS Trainer
bullets: Completed Andela's Train-a-Tutor program on NVIDIA RAPIDS; joined the trainer assessment team.
Trained hundreds of Andela Community members worldwide on GPU-accelerated data science.
Received the 2024 Passion Award for community contribution and impact.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Designed and developed ML/deep learning systems end to end — from data representation and prototyping to deployment and retraining.
Researched and implemented ML algorithms, ran experiments, and extended existing ML libraries and frameworks.

experience.title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer
bullets: Built ML models and retraining pipelines for healthcare research, primarily in R.
Built a Variational Autoencoder with a custom reparameterisation-trick layer using Keras' functional API, combining encoder/decoder into a full VAE for synthetic image generation.
